input.body:
Thanks & Best Regards,

Managing Director

Sherif Shaaban


16 Fawzy Fahmy Gendy St., 21131

El Raml Station, Alexandria, Egypt

From: ETMS Management <management@etm-services.net> 
Sent: Thursday, 9 August 2018 20:57
To: 'Varan Shipping - Chartering Dept.' <chartering@varanshipping.com>
Subject: fixture recap

 

SERKAN

 

 

 

MV Humbold Bay - Safi / Georgetown - Account Messers SIS marine 

 

 

 Please find below THE FIXTURE RECAP SUB STEM 

 

- MV Humbold Bay as per description received

 

 

Present Position: Off Madeira, ETA SAFI wihin 1 day after clean fixing

DWCC: 4000 MT on 6.5 M

Owners: Seatrade Group NV

Managers: Seatrade Groningen BV

Plan attached in description

Masters Plan Reverting on Fixing (one tier only)

 

 

 

OWNERS CONFIRM THAT VESSEL HAS/WILL HAVE ALL P&I, HM AND CLASS CERTIFICATES
VALID THROUGHOUT THE VOYAGE. 

 

- ACCT:  SIS MARINE SERVICES  AND SHIP MANAGEMENT CO LTD - ISTANBUL (last
fixture MV Green Magic - c/p dd June 2018 - Antalya / Georgetown)

- PORT OF LOADING: 1 GSB AAAA Safi

- PORT OF DISCHARGING: 1 GSB AAAA Georgetown, Guyana

- OWNER TO CHECK AND SATISFY THEMSELVES ABOUT RESTRICTIONS, FACILITIES OF
THE PORTS/BERTHS AT BOTH ENDS. 

- Transit time about 8/9 days WP WOG

- LAYCAN: 13-15 AUGUST 2018

- LOADING RATE : 1500 TONS PER WW DAY SSHINC

- DISCHARGING RATE : 1000 TONS PER WORKING HATCH PER WW DAY SSHINC 

- Min  3500 MTONS IN CHOPT UP TO 4,000 TONS  OF  BARYTE IN  BIG BAGS DIMS
1.5 MT BIG BAGS MAX 5 TIERS ABT 110X110X65 CM

- OWNERS WARRANTTO LOAD ALL CARGO WITH 6.9 METER DRAFT ARRIVAL GUAYANA 

- Demerara Channel at low tide (chart datum) is 5.9 m plus rise of the tide
(varies between 1-2.5 m).

- CARGO   HARMLESS NON DANGEROUS.

- NOR NOT TO BE TENDERED BEFORE THE LAYCAN, ANY TIME USED BEFORE
COMMENCEMENT OF LAYTIME NOT TO COUNT

- FRT USD 55,-- PMT FREE IN OUT  BASIS 1/1 

- IF ANY LASHING /SECURING  /DUNNAGING NEEDED TO BE FOR CHARTERERS  ACCOUNT

- FREIGHT PAYABLE LESS COMMISSION WITHIN 5 BANKING DAYS  UPON SIGNING
RELEASEING CLEAN ON BOARD BILLS OF LADING  IN ANY CASE BBB. 

- FREIGHT PREPAID BSL TO BE ISSUED AND SAME TO REMAIN IN LOAD PORT AGENTS
CUSTODY TILL OWNERS RECEIVE FREIGHT  INTO THEIR BANK ACCOUNT 

- MASTER HAS THE RIGHT TO REJECT CARGO WHICH DOESN NOT CORRESPOND TO COB
BS/L 

- TIME LOST FOR SUBSTITUTION OF SUCH UNCLEAN CARGO TO COUNT AS LAYTIME OR
TIME ON DEMURRAGE 

- DEMURRAGE USD 8,500 PDPR/FD ALL ENDS.

- DEMURRAGE, IF ANY, IS PAYABLE WITHIN 10 BDAYS AFTER OWNERS REPRESENTSTION
OF SOF, NOR AND OWNERS UNDISPUTED LAYTIME CALCULATIONS BY FAX OR EMAIL

 

-LOAD PORT AGENT :

 Agence Maritime Africaine de l'atlantique (AGEMAFRIC)

Email : info@agemafric.ma <mailto:info@agemafric.ma>  /
agemafric@agemafric.ma <mailto:agemafric@agemafric.ma> 

Te : +212 522 317336 / 317258

Pic : Mr Azzeddine Tazi : Mob +212 661 312426

Pic : Mr Abelilllah Hajjar : Mob + 212 661 463935

Pic : Mr Jamal Ounmar : Mob +212 661 748643

 

-DIS PORT AGENT :

Richard DeNobrega Operations Director t.592 223 3770   m.592 600 3454 23 

Brickdam Stabroek, Georgetown, Guyana

E-MAIL : richard.denobrega@rampslogistics.com
<mailto:richard.denobrega@rampslogistics.com> 

www.rampslogistics.com <http://www.rampslogistics.com> 

 

- NO SUBS ON D/A 

- CONGEN BILLS 94 TO BE USED AND C/P DATE TO BE INSERTED ON THE FRONT PAGE
ON BS/L  

- IF ANY SHIFTING EXPENSES BETWEEN 2 BERTHS DUE TO CARGO OPERATION TO BE FR
CHRTS ACCT AND TIME TO COUNT AS LAYTIME.

- FREE USE OF VESSEL CRANES AT LOAD / DISCHARGE PORT IF ALLOWED BY
AUTHORITIES BENDS .

- CARGO TO BE LOADED  AS PER SHORE SCALE /TALLY   OWNERS  HAS RIGHT TO  DO
THEIR OWN TALLY 

- VESSEL  OWNERS  RESPONSIBLE FOR THE  NUMBERS OF  BIG BAGS ONLY.

- HOLIDAYS, INCLUDING LOCAL HOLIDAYS AS PER BIMCO 2018 CALENDAR.

- AT LOADING PORT , NOR TO BE TENDERED DURING WORKING HOURS SSHEX  VIA
CABLE/VHF TLX/FAX/PH W/W/W/W AND TIME TO COUNT AS PER GENCON 0800/1400 HOURS
CLAUSE

- AT DISCHARGE PORT , NOR TO BE TENDERED DURING WORKING HOURS SSHINC VIA
CABLE/VHF TLX/FAX/PH W/W/W/W AND TIME TO COUNT AS PER GENCON 08/1400 HOURS
CLAUSE

- ALL TAXES/DUES /WHARFAGES ON VESSEL/FLAG/ FREIGHT /OWNERSHIP SHIP/ CREW(IF
ANY) TO BE FOR OWNERS' ACCOUNT AT BOTH ENDS. VSL IS FREE EXINS DUE TO HER
AGE&CLASS OWNERSHIP.

- ALL TAXES/DUES / WHARFAGES ON CARGO   (IF ANY) TO BE FOR
CHARTERERS'ACCOUNT AT BOTH ENDS OWNERS / VESSEL / MASTER / MANAGERS ARE TO
GIVE REGULAR AND PROPER NOTICES TO CHARTERERS' / BROKERS AND THEIR INDICATED
PARTIES AT LOADING PORT;  ON FIXING AND 2/1,  AND AT DISCHARGE 7/5/4/3/2/1
DAYS.

- ONCE ON DEMURRAGE ALWAYS ON DEMURRAGE

- ENGLISH LAW , Y-A RULES 1974 AS AMENDED 1990, OR ANY SUBSEQUENT
MODIFICATION THEREOF TO APPLY;

- ARBITRATION IN LONDON, LMAA PROCEDURE TO APPLY IRRESPECTIVE OF THE AMOUNT;

- "New Jason Clause" , Both to Blame Collision clause, Paramount Clause;.

- ALL THESE NEGOS TO BE KEPT FULLY PRIVATE AND CONFIDENTIAL AND NOT TO BE
DISCLOSED TO ANY 3RD PARTY.

- G/A ARBITRATION IN London, English LAW TO APPLY OTHERWISE AS PER CLEAN
GENCON 94 WITH 3.75 ADDRESS  COM + 1.25% COM TO ETMS ON F/D/D

-Sub owners to check/satisfy themselves with berth restrictions at both ends

-Sub charterers and owners reconfirmation within 8 working hours after
fixing main terms

 

 

END

 

Regards

Sherif

 



Tel : +20-3-4865320 / 4874667 / 4871895 
Fax : +20-3-4872855 
Address: 16 Fawzy fahmy Gendy st.21131 El Raml Station

Alexandria-Egypt 
 <http://www.etm-services.net/> www.etm-services.net 
 <mailto:management@etm-services.net> management@etm-services.net

 

 



--

additional_terms: NOR not to be tendered before laycan; any time used before commencement of laytime not to count.
Master has the right to reject cargo which does not correspond to COB B/L; time lost for substitution of unclean cargo to count as laytime or time on demurrage.
CONGEN Bills 94 to be used and C/P date to be inserted on the front page of B/L.
If any shifting expenses between 2 berths due to cargo operation to be for charterers' account and time to count as laytime.
Free use of vessel cranes at load/discharge port if allowed by authorities, both ends.
Cargo to be loaded as per shore scale/tally; owners have the right to do their own tally. Vessel owners responsible for the number of big bags only.
Holidays including local holidays as per BIMCO 2018 calendar.
All taxes/dues/wharfages on vessel/flag/freight/ownership/crew (if any) to be for owners' account at both ends. Vessel is free of extra insurance due to her age and class/ownership.
All taxes/dues/wharfages on cargo (if any) to be for charterers' account at both ends.

Owners/vessel/master/managers to give regular and proper notices to charterers/brokers and their indicated parties at loading port: on fixing and 2/1 days prior; at discharge port: 7/5/4/3/2/1 days prior.
New Jason Clause, Both to Blame Collision Clause, Paramount Clause to apply.
No subs on D/A (disbursement accounts).
Owners confirm vessel has/will have all P&I, H&M and class certificates valid throughout the voyage.
Owner to check and satisfy themselves about restrictions and facilities of the ports/berths at both ends.
Demerara Channel at low tide (chart datum) is 5.9 m plus rise of tide (varies between 1–2.5 m).
Cargo harmless, non-dangerous.
Masters plan reverting on fixing (one tier only).
NOR tendering at loading port: SSHEX working hours, via cable/VHF/TLX/fax/phone, W/W/W/W, time to count as per GENCON 0800/1400 hours clause.
NOR tendering at discharge port: SSHINC working hours, via cable/VHF/TLX/fax/phone, W/W/W/W, time to count as per GENCON 08/1400 hours clause.
WIPON WIBON WIFPON WCCON — not explicitly stated but standard GENCON 94 NOR conditions apply; actual NOR tendering conditions per loading/discharge clauses above.
Present position: Off Madeira; ETA Safi within 1 day after clean fixing.

unknown_terms.context: DEMURRAGE USD 8,500 PDPR/FD ALL ENDS — PDPR = Per Day Pro Rata, FD = Full Despatch. Combination is standard but 'ALL ENDS' confirms despatch applies at both load and discharge ports. Noted for completeness as despatch rate is not separately quantified in the recap.

Used in context of NOR tendering method: 'VIA CABLE/VHF TLX/FAX/PH W/W/W/W' — likely means 'whether working or not working' / any means of communication, or alternatively Weather Working / Working Weather. Exact operational meaning in this NOR context requires broker clarification.

unknown_terms.term: VSL IS FREE EXINS DUE TO HER AGE&CLASS OWNERSHIP
unknown_terms.context: Vessel is free of extra insurance (EXINS) due to her age and class/ownership. The specific basis for exemption from extra insurance surcharge is not standard and may require owners to confirm with charterers' underwriters.

3.75% address commission — unusually high address commission (normally 1.25%). Typically address commission is returned to charterers, but at 3.75% this may reflect a combined broker/address structure. Broker to confirm split and recipient.

CONGEN Bills 94 — reference to BIMCO Congenbill 1994 form bill of lading. Recognized but noted as the recap specifies '94' version specifically; confirm whether CONGENBILL 2016 revision is acceptable or if 1994 version is mandated.
